The script's rule, in order:

1. Keeps the top 4,000 movies by rating count (ties broken by movieId), then drops every rating not on those movies.
2. Keeps users with at least 20 ratings on the kept movies ("eligible").
3. Includes every eligible user who tagged at least one kept movie, then adds a random sample of the remaining eligible users so the total lands close to 5,000,000 without going over 5,500,000 (110%).
4. Keeps `tags.csv` rows only for kept movies and included users, and trims `movies.csv`/`links.csv` to the kept movies.

So the cut order is: movies first (by popularity), then users (by an activity floor, with taggers prioritized), and tags/links just follow whichever rows survive.
